name: Motorcycle
description: Any vehicle with a saddle for the rider, designed to travel on no more than three wheels, other than a tractor; a road-registered electric motorcycle is one. The motor driven cycle is split off only by a 50 cc engine displacement, and the licence endorsements only by engine size, with no electric equivalent.

restrictions.rule: A saddle for the rider and no more than three wheels on the ground; no power or speed limits
restrictions.citation: Motor Vehicle Act, RSNB 1973, c M-17, s. 1

restrictions.rule: Riders need a licence endorsed valid for motorcycle (Class 6), after holding a motorcycle learner's licence for 12 months and passing a road test
restrictions.citation: Motor Vehicle Act, RSNB 1973, c M-17, ss. 78(2), 84.11(6); General Regulation, N.B. Reg. 83-42, s. 22

restrictions.rule: The learner's licence is available from age 16, after a licensed motorcycle training course and the written exams; a learner may not carry a passenger, tow, ride between sunset and sunrise or have any alcohol in their blood
restrictions.citation: Motor Vehicle Act, RSNB 1973, c M-17, s. 84.11

restrictions.rule: Every rider and passenger must wear a motorcycle helmet meeting a listed standard
restrictions.citation: Motor Vehicle Act, RSNB 1973, c M-17, s. 229; General Regulation, N.B. Reg. 83-42, s. 38

restrictions.rule: Both hands on the handlebars and both feet on the footrests, seated on the permanent seat; a passenger only if it's designed for one
restrictions.citation: Motor Vehicle Act, RSNB 1973, c M-17, s. 199(1)

restrictions.rule: Needs a mirror on each side and a brake operable by hand or foot
restrictions.citation: Motor Vehicle Act, RSNB 1973, c M-17, ss. 233(2), 237(2)

restrictions.rule: Registered for $47 a year, and must carry motor vehicle liability insurance
restrictions.citation: Motor Vehicle Act, RSNB 1973, c M-17, s. 17.1; General Regulation, N.B. Reg. 83-42, s. 5

restrictions.rule: Entitled to a full traffic lane, but may not pass in the same lane or ride abreast another motorcycle except to pass
restrictions.citation: Motor Vehicle Act, RSNB 1973, c M-17, s. 199

restrictions.rule: One built for off-road use and not registered under the Motor Vehicle Act is an off-road vehicle instead
restrictions.citation: Off-Road Vehicle Act, SNB 1985, c O-1.5, s. 1
